name: Steve AI
description: 面向B2B软件公司的自主竞争情报代理，帮助精益营销和销售团队追踪竞争对手并赢得更多交易，整合公共数据源与企业内部销售电话、邮件和文档
description_en: An autonomous competitive intelligence agent for B2B software companies that helps lean marketing and sales teams track competitors and win more deals, integrating public sources with internal sales calls, emails, and documents
why_matters: 传统竞争情报工具成本高昂且需要专职研究人员，Steve AI通过自主运行让中小企业首次能够负担竞争情报服务，并提供专门的自建对比购买分析功能，帮助销售团队应对买家考虑内部开发的新竞争形态
why_matters_en: Traditional competitive intelligence tools require large budgets and dedicated researchers, while Steve AI runs autonomously to make competitive intelligence affordable for small and mid-sized businesses for the first time, and includes a dedicated build-vs-buy analysis feature to help sales teams address the emerging competitor of in-house development
latest_news: Trissino完成120万美元融资用于扩展Steve AI，产品已在六个国家拥有付费客户，公司已完成SOC 2认证并正在向企业市场扩张
latest_news_en: Trissino has raised $1.2M to scale Steve AI, which already has paying customers in six countries, has completed SOC 2 certification, and is expanding into the enterprise market
source_title: Trissino Raises $1.2M to Scale Steve AI, an Autonomous Competitive Intelligence Agent Built for a Market Where Moats Are Harder Than Ever to Build | Techstars

evidence.quote: San Francisco-based Trissino (Techstars 2025) has raised $1.2M to date to build and scale Steve AI

Steve AI includes a dedicated build-vs-buy analysis feature. When a prospect weighs building their own solution, Steve AI maps out where the vendor's product is stronger and more complete than an in-house build

name: Apate.ai
description: 部署数千个AI代理伪装成普通人与欺诈者互动，可接听诈骗电话、回复可疑消息和邮件、点击钓鱼链接并加入社交媒体群组，采用不同年龄、性别、口音并支持多语言，目的是让诈骗者保持足够长的互动时间以收集有用信息
description_en: Deploys thousands of AI agents that pose as unsuspecting people to engage fraudsters, answering scam calls, responding to suspicious messages and emails, following phishing links and joining social media groups, adopting different ages, genders and accents while speaking multiple languages to keep scammers engaged long enough to gather useful information
why_matters: 通过主动诱骗和拖延欺诈者，而非被动防御，收集诈骗情报，这种反向社会工程方法为网络安全提供了新的防御维度，可能帮助执法机构追踪诈骗网络
why_matters_en: Uses proactive scam-baiting rather than passive defense to gather fraud intelligence through reverse social engineering, providing a new defensive dimension for cybersecurity that could help law enforcement track scam networks
latest_news: 入围TechCrunch Disrupt 2026创业战场决赛，将于2026年10月15日在旧金山进行最终展示，竞争10万美元奖金
latest_news_en: Reached Startup Battlefield finals at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, scheduled to pitch on October 15, 2026 in San Francisco for $100,000 prize
source_title: Meet the Five Companies Competing in the Startup Battlefield Finals at Disrupt 2026 - Mezha.net

website_verification.title: Apate | AI powered fraud prevention and intelligence

evidence.quote: Apate deploys thousands of AI agents that pose as unsuspecting people to engage fraudsters. They can answer scam calls, respond to suspicious messages and emails, follow phishing links and join social media groups.

name: PataBid
description: 面向建筑行业的AI驱动工程估算工具，可在数小时内根据项目图纸生成估算，服务于电气、机械、消防和管道等领域的承包商
description_en: AI-powered construction estimating tool that prepares project estimates from drawings in hours, serving contractors in electrical, mechanical, fire protection, and plumbing sectors
why_matters: 传统建筑估算流程依赖手工和过时工具，PataBid的Quantify平台通过AI自动化替代这一痛点，目前正在开发名为Newton的代理AI进一步增强能力，在北美46.3万承包商的市场中具有显著增长空间
why_matters_en: Addresses a major pain point in construction by automating outdated manual estimating processes with AI; developing agentic AI 'Newton' for 2027 launch; serves market of 463,000 North American contractors with clear monetization model
latest_news: 2026年10月获得Graphite Ventures领投的200万美元pre-seed轮融资，用于加速产品商业化和北美市场扩张
latest_news_en: Raised $2 million pre-seed funding led by Graphite Ventures in October 2026 to accelerate commercialization and North American expansion
source_title: PataBid raises $2 million to expand AI construction estimator

evidence.quote: PataBid has raised $2 million in pre-seed funding to help accelerate the commercialization of its AI-powered construction estimating tool. The news: PataBid announced the funding on Tuesday, telling BetaKit the round was led by Graphite Ventures

PataBid's platform Quantify is marketed as a replacement for manual and legacy estimating tools used by the construction industry. Integrating AI, Quantify is capable of preparing estimates for construction projects based off of project drawings in a matter of hours
